items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: when Jimmy Clayton started to get, quote, hot, and you said, well, gee, he started using big writers' tunes, Sadaka, and people like that.

ctx.x: So far, so far. All right. Okay. For instance, now, there's one thing you can put on the tape. It's like the fourth reel. We've got two, first two half reels, so to speak, that we're squeaking. Yeah. And it's November 1st, 1993. Okay. Okay. Yeah.

No, what I was saying, when Jimmy Clayton started to get, quote, hot, and you said, well, gee, he started using big writers' tunes, Sadaka, and people like that. Right. One of the things you have to remember is that their publishers would pay you to use their songs. We used to get 1,000, 2,000, $3,000 to do. I forget which ones are which, but.
